stories.title: Airbus pays £6.4m to HMRC over export control breaches
stories.summary: Airbus Operations Limited has paid more than £6.4 million to HM Revenue and Customs after admitting multiple breaches of Strategic Export Controls.

stories.title: Home Office accused of using 'AI hallucinated' information in asylum case
stories.summary: A judge suggested the Home Office relied on AI-generated, factually incorrect information when refusing an asylum claim, raising concerns about AI use in immigration decisions.

stories.title: National partnership agreement on asylum seeker health published
stories.summary: The government published a national partnership agreement setting out how health and wellbeing needs of asylum seekers in England will be met from 2025-2028.

stories.title: UK government issues statement on situation in the West Bank
stories.summary: The FCDO and Minister Stephen Doughty issued a statement addressing the deteriorating situation in the West Bank.

stories.title: Opinion: Burnham urges UK to take international aid obligations seriously
stories.summary: A Guardian opinion piece argues the FCDO has become unfit for development purposes following DFID's abolition and departures of expert staff over Gaza policy disagreements.

stories.title: Connect to Work programme business case summary published
stories.summary: DWP published a summary of the Connect to Work programme, agreed to run 2025/26-2029/30 at an estimated £1.2bn cost with expected benefits of £2.6bn.

stories.title: Get Britain Working: Labour Market Insights, July 2026
stories.summary: DWP released its latest Get Britain Working labour market insights report for July 2026.

stories.title: Bluetongue virus a 'big issue' for South West farmers
stories.summary: Defra said farmers should watch for signs of the bluetongue virus, including fever, facial swelling and nasal discharge, as cases affect South West farms.

stories.title: Multi-agency crackdown on waste crime across East Lancashire
stories.summary: The Environment Agency, sponsored by Defra, led a multi-agency operation cracking down on waste crime across East Lancashire.

stories.title: MoD challenges public to spot the hidden sniper
stories.summary: A new MoD campaign shows how military personnel remain concealed during training, encouraging the public to try spotting a hidden sniper in a training area.

stories.title: £8.4bn investment announced for Dreadnought submarine programme
stories.summary: The Prime Minister announced a major £8.4 billion investment in the next stage of the UK's Dreadnought nuclear deterrent submarine build, supporting 22,000 apprenticeships.

stories.title: DBT to be renamed Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST)
stories.summary: The Department for Business and Trade will be renamed the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade as of 20 July 2026, per civil service job listings.

stories.title: SPS agreement: preparing your business
stories.summary: DBT published guidance on a new UK-EU strategic partnership on sanitary and phytosanitary rules for trade in plants, animals and food products.

stories.title: MKUH signs partnership agreement to deliver new hospital building
stories.summary: Milton Keynes University Hospital signed a partnership agreement with Morgan Sindall Construction, moving the new hospital building project from planning into delivery.

stories.title: Landmark NHS trial: specialist long Covid care may reduce fatigue
stories.summary: The largest clinical trial of long Covid care to date found that specialist NHS long Covid services may help reduce fatigue, one of the condition's most common symptoms.
